attribution: Constellation identities and J2000 boundary coordinates are from the International Astronomical Union official constellation material.
limitations: Boundaries are official sky regions, not artistic constellation drawings or star-to-star line conventions.
Boundary coordinates are represented at J2000.0; Gaia target evidence remains at its published J2016.0 catalogue reference epoch with no proper-motion propagation.
The runtime renders only the selected target constellation boundary and clips it at the geometric horizon.

target_membership.coordinate_source: Lumina accepted Gaia DR3 astrometry slice; exact source IDs and coordinates are frozen in the artifact.
target_membership.method: bounded offline point-in-region review against the IAU J2000 boundary vertices; no CDS B1875 boundary was used

usage_purpose: Official constellation region context for the Lumina Sky Finder.

verification_source.role: Independent official-abbreviation/count and boundary-reference check only; the VI/42 B1875 geometry is not used as the runtime boundary artifact.
